findings.title: Script exits with no output on missing required field
findings.what_was_tried: Ran the skill with a session JSON missing the 'scope' field
findings.what_happened: Python raised a KeyError and the process exited with code 1 and no user-facing message
findings.what_was_expected: A clear error message explaining which field is missing and how to fix it

evidence.output:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "run_skill.py", line 42, in <module>
    scope = data['scope']
KeyError: 'scope'

findings.suggested_next_step: Wrap field access in try/except and emit a structured error message before sys.exit(1)

findings.title: Severity badge renders wrong color for 'bug' level
findings.what_was_tried: Injected a finding with severity='bug' into the report renderer
findings.what_happened: The badge showed the 'blocker' red color instead of orange

findings.title: Template substitution fails when finding title contains a dollar sign
findings.what_was_tried: Used a finding title containing '$PATH' to test edge cases
findings.what_happened: string.Template raised ValueError: Invalid placeholder in string
findings.what_was_expected: Dollar signs in content should be escaped automatically before substitution

evidence.output: ValueError: Invalid placeholder in string: line 1, col 47

findings.suggested_next_step: Escape all user-supplied strings with `.replace('$', '$$')` before passing to Template.substitute()

findings.title: Report title hardcoded instead of using scope from JSON
findings.what_was_tried: Generated a report with scope='My Custom Skill'
findings.what_happened: The browser tab and <h1> always showed 'Dogfood Report' regardless of scope
findings.what_was_expected: Title and heading should reflect the actual scope value from the session JSON
findings.suggested_next_step: Replace hardcoded title with `${scope}` placeholder in the template

findings.title: XSS: finding title not HTML-escaped in output
findings.what_happened: The script tag was rendered unescaped into the HTML, executing in the browser
findings.what_was_expected: All user content should be HTML-escaped before insertion
findings.suggested_next_step: Use html.escape() on all user-supplied string values before substitution

findings.title: No shebang line in render_report.py
findings.what_was_tried: Tried to run the script directly: ./scripts/render_report.py
findings.what_was_expected: Script should have #!/usr/bin/env python3 and be executable
findings.suggested_next_step: Add `#!/usr/bin/env python3` as the first line and run `chmod +x scripts/render_report.py`
